title: The Roads Held
summary: Vrakthar's horde broke against the trade roads and scattered back into the wildlands. Order wins the day, and with it, the Enforcers' grip on every chartered road in the reach tightens. It isn't the freest ending, but the roads are safe, and that was always the point.
condition: Complete the Enforcers' final commission: defeat Vrakthar the Unbound.

title: Before It Woke
summary: The Brazen Warden falls before its warding is complete, a heap of cooling bronze and broken sigils. Freedom wins, but the roads stay exactly as dangerous and lawless as they always were — which, to the Outlaws, was never really the problem.
condition: Complete the Outlaws' final commission: destroy the Brazen Warden.

title: The Unbeaten, Beaten
summary: Kestra Vane goes down in a straight fight, no tricks and no politics, and the contract board has a new name at the top of it: yours. The undisputed strongest blade-for-hire in the land, for whatever that title is worth to the next challenger who comes looking.
condition: Complete the Mercenaries' final commission: defeat Kestra Vane.

title: What Stays Asleep
summary: Threnval the Ashen Wyrm is driven back into a deep and, this time, better-warded sleep. The Order's archives grow by one very careful, very redacted volume, and the world keeps turning without ever knowing how close it came.
condition: Complete the Order of the Arcane's final commission: contain Threnval, the Ashen Wyrm.

title: The Ledger of No House
summary: No guild banner ever flew over your caravan, and none was needed. One hundred thousand gold pieces, earned wagon-load by wagon-load on nothing but the strength of a good eye for a fair price. The coin in your strongbox answers to nobody but you.
condition: Reach 100,000 gold through trade alone — no guild commission required.
